items: Restaurant data analytics turns data from your POS, kiosks, ordering apps and reviews into insights about customers, menus and costs, and it works best when those tools are integrated.
Sales history helps you forecast demand, so you can schedule the right staff for busy and slow shifts, order the right ingredients and cut food waste.
Item sales and customer feedback show which dishes to keep, promote or drop, and help you investigate why a once-popular item stopped getting reorders.
Guest data on order preferences, visit frequency and reservation habits lets you segment customers, reward loyal regulars and send personalized offers they're more likely to use.
Tracking no-shows, wait times and sales dips helps you fill empty tables with measures like reservation deposits or timely special offers.
